associations.rationale: The declaration constructs a linear equivalence from the conjugate space to the dual from an inner-product core, but its type does not state equivariance under a group action.
Assuming invariance of the inner product, the displayed equality says exactly that the conjugate-to-dual equivalence intertwines the conjugate and dual group actions.
This theorem supplies an equivariant equivalence for finite-group representations, but its type does not state that a given invariant unitary form induces that equivalence.
